watches.name: REVERSE MIAMI
watches.description: The spirit of Miami, in pink. With Reverse Miami, Electra pours all the carefree energy of Miami into a pink edition. Inspired by the world of Miami Vice , its neon lights, sunsets and flamingos, it pairs a pink sunray dial with three ice-blue counters for a sporty, assertive watch you recognise at first glance. A palette straight from Miami. Pink and ice blue create a sharp graphic contrast that echoes the city's signature tones: sky, neon and flamingos. A black tachymeter bezel gives it a sportier edge, while the white FKM strap adds a summery touch and a nod to the white jackets of one of the cult series' legendary characters. Sporty and versatile. The 40 mm stainless steel case alternates brushed and polished surfaces. With 47 mm lug-to-lug and 12 mm thickness excluding the sapphire crystal, it sits with balanced presence on the wrist. Water-resistant to 101 metres, with an anti-reflective sapphire crystal, it goes from the city to the water's edge without changing watch. Quartz precision, mechanical pleasure. At its heart, Seiko's TMI VK63 MechaQuartz hybrid chronograph combines quartz accuracy for timekeeping with a mechanical chronograph module, keeping the chronograph hand smooth as it starts. Chronograph, small seconds, 60-minute counter and 24-hour display, with the crisp, instant reset that makes MechaQuartz so satisfying. Reverse Miami is assembled in Morteau, at the heart of French watchmaking know-how. Miami in spirit, Electra in style. Pink, ice blue, white: Reverse Miami fully embraces colour, for those who want a real dose of Miami on the wrist.

watches.name: MIAMI SUNSET
watches.description: The spirit of Miami, embodied in a diver. Miami Sunset is a brand-new interpretation of Electra's Dare-Devil Diver, inspired by a city like no other. On a 38 mm diver, it captures Miami's most recognisable contrasts: the intense pink of sun-drenched façades and the neon lights of Vice City. A dial never seen before. The real signature of this edition is its dial. Electra debuts a new construction here: a gradient flowing from pink through violet to blue, in a lacquered and enamelled finish. Depending on the light, the tones melt into one another, giving the dial a unique depth. The colours are cut by a white ceramic bezel whose graphic presence contrasts with the dial. Its blue lume comes alive in the dark, alongside the indexes and hands. The oversized triangular indexes, a hallmark of the Dare-Devil, sharpen its visual identity and keep reading direct and legible when the light fades. A white FKM strap completes the look. A sports watch, precisely regulated. Beneath this spectacular look, Miami Sunset remains a true sports watch, built on the Dare-Devil Diver architecture with a 38 mm stainless steel case. It is powered by the Swiss Soprod P024 automatic calibre, with around 38 hours of power reserve, regulated to an average daily rate between -2 and +2 seconds. Assembly and regulation are carried out in Morteau, the historic cradle of French watchmaking. Electra did not set out to reproduce the codes of a classic diver. Miami Sunset subverts them through colour, volume and light. A new dial. An unexpected palette. A Dare-Devil that is pure Miami.

watches.name: DIVER ELECTRUM
watches.description: Long before gold became the universal symbol of wealth, there was Electrum. A naturally occurring alloy of gold and silver, Electrum was treasured by ancient civilizations for its unique glow and rarity. Used by the Egyptians to adorn sacred objects and chosen by the Lydians to mint the world's first coins, it represented prestige, innovation, and timeless beauty. Today, Electra Watches reinterprets this forgotten legend through a modern sports watch designed for collectors who appreciate both history and contemporary craftsmanship.

watches.name: FROST
watches.description: An arctic pulse beneath the surface. DDD Frost captures the tension between extreme clarity and raw depth. Its ice-blue fumé dial radiates from a frozen core, shifting from glacial light to oceanic blue depending on the angle. The contrast with the black bezel sharpens the silhouette, giving it a crisp, technical presence. The triangular markers and sculpted hands cut through the dial like precision instruments, while the electric blue seconds hand adds a subtle surge of energy a reminder that even in stillness, power moves. Mounted on a white strap, Frost feels clean, bold, and unapologetically modern. A diver built for those who thrive in cold clarity and controlled intensity.

watches.name: BLACK HOLE GOLD JAPANESE INK
watches.description: Light disappears. Character remains. An exploration of pure absorption, a dial so deep it feels infinite. Inspired by extreme black finishes, it eliminates distraction and amplifies form. The result is radical minimalism with maximum impact. The matte black surface creates a dramatic contrast against the polished steel case and the sharp geometric markers. Every reflection belongs to the case architecture — never the dial. Stealthy yet refined, Musou Black is about restraint. It doesn’t shout. It dominates quietly. A diver for those who understand that true presence doesn’t need volume.

watches.name: YELLOW OLD GOLD
watches.description: The edge of our Yellow Old Gold dial reveals a silver minute track, complemented by meticulously crafted applied silver indices. The triangular indices are enhanced with numerals at the 3, 6, 9, and 12 o'clock positions, while retro-inspired stick indices, reminiscent of the late 60s and early 70s, mark the other hours. Three centrally positioned silver hands sweep across the dial. The slender second hand features a "syringe" shape for counting seconds, while the shorter hand indicates the hours, and the longer hand, designed with a pointed tip followed by an arrow, marks the minutes. All our hands are generously filled with SuperLuminova, glowing blue in the dark while appearing white in daylight. Beneath the 12 o'clock position, our logo is applied along with the brand name. The logo uniquely blends gold and silver, symbolizing our brand's identity and paying homage to the contrast between our steel case and the gold indices and hands. Finally, between the 6 o'clock index and the center of the dial, we've included the inscription " Automatic 666 Feet " in two lines, indicating that our mechanical watch is automatic and water-resistant to 666 feet (203 meters).

watches.name: FORMAL BLACK
watches.description: The perimeter of the glossy dial reveals a gold minute track, complemented by applied gold indices that have required meticulous craftsmanship. The triangle indices are enhanced with numerals at 3, 6, 9, and 12 o'clock. For the remaining hours, we adopted retro-inspired stick indices, reminiscent of late 1960s and early 1970s design. Three centered gold hands sweep across the dial. The slender second hand is in the form of a "syringe" needle, counting the seconds, while the small hand marks the hours, and the large hand, featuring a unique arrow-tipped design, tracks the minutes. All our hands are generously filled with SuperLuminova, and we’ve chosen the Green Lume which appears Yellow when not activated—a unique and relatively rare, a luminescent treatment to ensure better readability in the dark, harmonizing perfectly with our gold indices and hands. Beneath the 12 o'clock marker, our logo is applied along with the brand name. The logo is a distinctive blend of gold and silver, symbolizing our brand and nodding to the contrast between our stainless steel case and the gold indices and hands. Finally, between the 6 o'clock index and the center of the dial, we’ve included the two-line inscription "Automatic 666 Feet," signifying that our mechanical watch is self-winding and water-resistant up to 666 feet (203 meters). Specifically for the Black model, a high-quality red rubber strap is provided, adding a touch of color to this very elegant watch.
